# Question: Did free school meals change attendance at participating schools? Cite sources.

## Answer
Average attendance at the 12 participating schools increased 3 percent in the year after free school meals began [S1]. A state audit found that average attendance at participating schools decreased 1 percent after adjusting for enrollment changes [S2].

## Evidence
- The audit used state attendance records [S2].

## Counter-evidence and limits
- The district evaluation did not adjust for enrollment changes [S1].

## Next actions
- Compare the two attendance datasets school by school (judgment)

## Sources
- [S1] District free meals evaluation
- [S2] State audit of the free meals program
